messages:
Marta Rivera: Heads-up — spotted a bunch of mismatches between the in-console doc panel copy and the docs site while reviewing the rollout flows. Main items: 'Pin version' vs 'Freeze version', 'Dedicated' vs 'Reserved capacity', and no cross-link from the Model Versions table to the quantization guidance.

Sam O'Leary: Ugh yes. I saw 'Pin' in the UI but the docs call it 'Freeze' — that will confuse customers. Also the panel doesn't mention the small-print about KMS use (we have that on docs). :grimacing:

Akash Patel: On the console side the panel is a very narrow slot — long copy breaks layout so we cut phrases. We could add a short label + 'Learn more' link that goes to the specific anchor. Low effort.

Ellie Zhang: I can change docs to use the same lexicon provided PMs agree. Proposal: standardize on 'Pin version' (user-facing) and keep 'freeze' as internal term in engineering docs. Suggested copy for panel: "Pin version — prevent automatic rollouts for this route. Learn more." That keeps it compact.

Marta Rivera: That sounds good. Can we also add a cross-link from the Model Versions table row to /docs/serving/model-versions#pinning? That solves the missing quantization/rollout guidance too.

Akash Patel: Link is fine. Small technical note: adding outbound links from tables requires a change to the cell renderer, small PR. I can take it but need 2 hours of frontend time. Also accessibility nit: the panel close button isn't in the tab order when opened via keyboard — I couldn't hit it with tab after focus trap.

Sam O'Leary: a11y fix is higher priority; we'll triage it as a patch. @Ellie can you add an a11y checklist item in the doc for the panel (keyboard, aria-label, focus order)?

Ellie Zhang: Yep — adding a short checklist item and the suggested copy. Also will add the exact anchor: /docs/serving/model-versions#pinning

docs-bot: PR opened by Ellie: https://git.internal.redwood-inference.dev/ellie/docs/456 — change 'Freeze version' -> 'Pin version', add anchor, checklist.

Akash Patel: I'll open the console PR to wire the 'Learn more' link and fix focus trap: https://git.internal.redwood-inference.dev/akash/console/789. ETA tomorrow morning.

Marta Rivera: Perfect. Can we aim to ship the copy + link next release and the a11y fix as a hotfix if needed? Also let's update the release note entry so CS knows the wording changed.

Sam O'Leary: Agreed. I'll add the release note and ping CS.

deploy-bot: Deployed staging build with docs copy change preview at https://staging.console.redwood.ai/ (build 2026-03-23-17:22). Please smoke test keyboard flow.

Akash Patel: smoke-tested — keyboard flow now hits modal close after fix branch merged to staging. One minor visual: the 'Learn more' link color is the same as links in the table; we should use low-contrast per brand. I'll tweak.

Ellie Zhang: I'll update the doc anchor label to 'Pinning and rollouts' for clarity.

Marta Rivera: Thanks everyone — created a small ticket to track remaining cleanup: https://tickets.redwood.ai/INC-3212. If no objections I'll mark the naming change final and update copy guide.

Sam O'Leary: No objections from me. :thumbsup:

Akash Patel: fine by eng.

Ellie Zhang: fine by docs.

Marta Rivera: Closing the thread — will follow up in the ticket for final verbiage.
